basis: R2 panel generation b216a53e (committed 2026-10-28, release 01fbe4d8): evidence/releases/2026-10-26-r2/final/evidence/measurements/sizes21.txt and final/README.md. committed_bytes is the measured figure; budgets allow 3% growth, rounded up to 1000 B. Blocks the R2.1 panel (generation e3965439, the payload main builds) changed are re-measured on it: strategies, performance, performance_tab, weekly_returns. Raise a budget only in the change that grows the block, and state the reason for it under justifications.

justifications.strategies: R2 committed 121117 B, R2.1 131808 B (+10691 B). The growth is new per-strategy evidence, not per-observation duplication: cost_components +3978 B (5 rows), execution_cost +2241 B (7 rows), corroboration +2100 B and declared +647 B (2 rows), provider_annualization and provider-comparison disposition and window fields about +1600 B. Trimming was examined and declined: repeated long strings inside the new fields total about 1200 B (under 1% of the block) and source.artifact, sha256 and artifact paths are provenance that tests pin. Limit = committed + 3%, rounded up to 1000 B.
justifications.performance: New top-level block (distinct from performance_tab) carried since R2: 54048 B on R2 b216a53e, 54055 B on R2.1. It was unlisted and sat 4 KB over the 50000 B unlisted-block threshold, so the checker flagged it on every generation. Within 7 B between R2 and R2.1. Limit = committed + 3%, rounded up to 1000 B.
justifications.performance_tab: R2.1 re-measure 381004 B (schema 3: union grid, flow-matched benchmarks), against 375785 B on the r21-integration panel the previous limit was cut from. The limit is re-cut at committed + 3% (393000 B, was 388000 B at 98.2% of committed) so the block has the same headroom every other block has.
justifications.weekly_returns: R2.1 re-measure 27773144 B against 27317555 B at R2 (+1.7%). Per-observation series are the block this budget exists to watch, so the limit is re-cut at committed + 3% (28607000 B, was 28138000 B at 97.4% of committed); further growth needs its own reason.
